 Aikido Security announces $60m Series B investment, with participation from PSG Equity
 January 14th, 2026
Aikido Security announces $60m Series B investment, with participation from PSG Equity
Funding to accelerate global expansion, and advance Aikido’s vision for self-securing software
Brussels and London – 14 January 2026 – Aikido Security today announced its $60m Series B funding round led by DST Global with participation from PSG Equity, a leading growth equity firm that partners with software and technology-enabled services companies.
Founded in 2022 in Ghent by Willem Delbare, Roeland Delrue and Felix Garriau, Aikido builds developer-first security products designed for how modern software is built and released. Aikido helps teams continuously reduce real, exploitable risk without slowing down development, by embedding security directly into engineering workflows and automating testing, validation, and remediation.
The funding will support Aikido’s next phase of growth, including continued product innovation, international expansion, and investment in top engineering and go-to-market talent. The round also deepens PSG Equity’s partnership with Aikido, supporting the rollout of developer-first, AI-native security across PSG Equity’s portfolio of more than 160 leading software companies.
“We’re excited to deepen our partnership with PSG Equity as we enter the next phase of Aikido’s growth,” said Willem Delbare, Co-Founder and CEO of Aikido. “Their experience scaling software companies globally makes them a strong partner as we continue building category-leading security products and pushing toward our vision of self-securing software.”
“Aikido delivers a compelling AI-first approach that addresses one of the fastest-growing priorities in software development. The platform stands out for its clarity, automation and ability to embed security directly into developer workflows. We see strong potential for Aikido to support many companies across PSG Equity’s portfolio, and we are pleased to be part of the company’s next phase of growth”, said Matthieu Sagnier, Managing Director at PSG Equity.
About Aikido Security
Founded in Ghent, Belgium, Aikido Security builds developer-first security products, with a vision for self-securing software. By combining context from code, cloud, and runtime environments, Aikido helps teams continuously reduce real risk without slowing down development. Aikido is trusted by over 50,000 organizations including the Premier League, SoundCloud, and Niantic.
About PSG Equity
PSG Equity is a growth equity firm that partners with software and technology-enabled services companies to help them navigate transformational growth, capitalize on strategic opportunities, and build strong teams. Having backed more than 160 companies and facilitated over 530 add-on acquisitions, PSG Equity brings extensive investment experience, deep expertise in software and technology, and a firm commitment to collaborating with management teams. Founded in 2014, PSG Equity operates out of offices in Boston, London, Madrid and Paris. To learn more about PSG Equity, visit www.psgequity.com.
